title: Oliver Hartwell and Clara Venn
text: Oliver Hartwell married Clara Venn in 2016. Clara was known in Hartwell's family for her quiet humor and careful memory. Public records in Larkford list Clara Venn as Oliver Hartwell's wife. Clara Venn began her clinical career at St. Brigid's Children's Hospital. She worked there as a pediatric nurse from 2012 to 2016. Her duties included night rounds and discharge planning. Clara Venn later joined North Quay Medical Center. She worked in its pediatric ward from 2017 to 2021. The hospital newsletter described her as a senior nurse. Clara Venn attended a short training course at Alderwick General Hospital. The course focused on emergency triage for children. She did not hold a staff position there.

title: Naomi Calder
text: Naomi Calder worked at Alderwick General Hospital after finishing medical school. She joined the internal medicine department in 2011. Her early work focused on respiratory infections. Naomi Calder later worked at St. Brigid's Children's Hospital. She served on its pediatric asthma team from 2016 to 2019. Several hospital reports list her as a consulting physician. Naomi Calder gave a lecture at North Quay Medical Center in 2020. The lecture was about rural vaccination programs. She visited the hospital for one day.

title: Priya Voss
text: Priya Voss worked at Alderwick General Hospital from 2014 to 2018. She was part of the same internal medicine unit that handled respiratory cases. Her staff profile remained online after she left. Priya Voss also worked at St. Brigid's Children's Hospital. She joined its pediatric asthma team in 2019. Her role involved patient follow-up and family counseling. Priya Voss studied at Merrowgate Medical College. She completed a student placement at Eastmere Clinic. Neither institution employed her as a doctor.
